parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The timeline of the online editing job. For data structure, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198823.html.
<notice>Either ProjectId or Timeline must be provided.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
云剪辑任务时间线。具体结构定义，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198823.html。
<notice> ProjectId、Timeline 两个参数二选一必填></notice>
parameters.name: timeline

parameters.help_en:
The export type. Valid values:

BaseTimeline: exports the timeline.

AdobePremierePro: exports an Adobe Premiere Pro project
parameters.help_zh:
工程导出类型。取值：
BaseTimeline：时间线。
AdobePremierePro: Adobe PR 工程。当前仅上海、北京、杭州、深圳区域支持，其余区域不支持
parameters.name: export_type

parameters.help_en:
The output path for the exported project and generated intermediate files, in JSON format. The export destination only supports OSS. Path fields:

Bucket: Required. The OSS bucket name.

Prefix: Optional. The path prefix. If not specified, it defaults to the root directory.

Width: Optional. The width of the output. The value must be a positive integer. If not provided, the system automatically calculates the value based on the input project or timeline.

Height: Optional. The height of the output. The value must be a positive integer. If not provided, the system automatically calculates the value based on the input project or timeline
parameters.help_zh:
导出结果以及产生的中间文件输出路径，JSON 格式。目前仅支持输出到用户OSS上。包含以下字段：
Bucket：OSS bucket名称，必填。
Prefix：生成文件的路径前缀， 非必填，不填时默认为根目录。
Width: 目标成片的宽，正整数。非必填，不填时根据传入的剪辑工程或者时间线自动估算。
Height: 目标成片的高，正整数。非必填，不填时根据传入的剪辑工程或者时间线自动估算
